# One Star Review

I purchased this foam mattress with high hopes based on the positive reviews, but I was deeply disappointed. Within just two weeks, the mattress had developed an obvious body-shaped indent that makes sleeping uncomfortable and defeats the purpose of having a supportive bed. The chemical smell from the foam was overwhelming and lingered for over a month despite leaving windows open and airing it out constantly. The mattress is far too soft for my liking, providing virtually no support for my back, and I wake up with aches and pains every morning. The cover is cheaply made and started pilling after minimal use, making the entire mattress look worn out already. The company's return process was unnecessarily complicated and frustrating, requiring multiple phone calls and weeks of back-and-forth communication. For the price I paid, I expected much better quality and durability than what this mattress delivered. I absolutely would not recommend this product to anyone and regret wasting my money on it.
